title: Duration-aware dependency schedule in an authorized projection
description: Conditional dependency scheduling from explicit dependent-to-prerequisite edges and qualified nonnegative integer durations. Omit capacity for unlimited earliest/latest offsets, slack and critical chain; supply 1..64 identical slots for a deterministic nonpreemptive model with actual model offsets, queue delays, slot assignments and a separate unchanged unlimited baseline. Supplied capacity is assumed, not observed worker availability, and the heuristic makes no optimality claim. Optional generation-fenced targets select their complete transitive prerequisite closure; omitted or empty targets select all vertices. Every selected prerequisite requires a usable duration. Cycles, unavailable durations, overflow and exhausted budgets refuse the complete result. Units are those of the named source field; worker eligibility, materials, travel and native completion are not established. No observation, plan, effect or authority is created. Runtime additionally checks UTF-8 byte lengths, u64 IDs, duplicate entity IDs, complete source custody, work, wall and final output budgets.

capacity.description: Assumed number of identical nonpreemptive slots. Zero-duration work consumes no slot. Omit for the unchanged unlimited model; null is refused.
